run_match_simulation: run a MiniRTS behavior cloning match between a learned executor AI and a MediumAI bot
create_game: create multiple MiniRTS game instances with CheatExecutorAI and MediumAI bots using tube context
parse_args: parse command line arguments for seed, GPU, frame skip, resource bins, and model paths
get_game_option: build an RTSGameOption object from parsed args with seed, resource, and replay settings
get_ai_options: create two AIOption objects with frame skip, fog of war, and instruction count settings
